description: Return one rule's definition: what it checks, severity, requirement, scope, which pages and site types it applies to, the official source link and version, and whether the rule is active, draft or retired (with the retirement reason). Use it to explain a finding, to cite the rule's source, or to decide which rule to check next. Requires the rules:read scope; reads only the database.

ruleId.description: Rule id as returned by get_audit_findings, check_url or audit_url.

name: get_rule
title: Read one audit rule definition
